title: PAR-138 DetailViewStyle group-4 line color insertion fast slice
mode: Generated ASCII/Binary implementation and focused regression validation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Insert missing DetailViewStyle group-4 connection/border line color values (DXF group 62) during same-version raw-carrier export.
Preserve repeated color occurrence mapping when an edited later field follows an omitted earlier field.
Verify generated ASCII/Binary output with exact ordered raw groups, typed readback, reference closure, and neighboring-record continuity.

implementation.behavior: The raw-carrier overlay inserts missing group-4 color occurrences through the highest edited connection/border slot. If border color is edited while connection color is omitted and still defaulted, it emits the current/default connection color 256 before the border value. Values are checked against the signed 16-bit DXF color range.
testCases: Remove both group-4 group-62 values from the generated primary DetailViewStyle, confirm typed defaults, edit border color to 77, export/reimport in ASCII and Binary DXF, and assert ordered values 256 then 77.
Compare complete ordered raw DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle carriers, verify typed readback and closed references, and ensure the following POINT is intact.

limitations: Same-source-version DXF typed-field insertion/replay only; no DWG-origin typed serialization or cross-version projection qualification.
The control verifies one later-slot insertion with its default predecessor; it does not cover every color combination or malformed cardinality.
No native color interpretation or broad DetailViewStyle semantic-completeness claim follows.
The shared worktree is uncommitted and contains unrelated user changes; no cleanup or staging was performed.
